title: Koyra Chiini language - Wikipedia
text: Koyra Chiini, or Western Songhay, is a member of the Songhay languages spoken in Mali by about 200,000 people along the Niger River in Timbuktu and upriver from it in the towns of Diré, Tonka, Goundam and Niafunké as well as in the Saharan town of Araouane to its north.

title: Songhay languages - Wikipedia
text: Songhay is mostly a tonal, subject–object–verb (SOV) group of languages, an exception being the divergent Koyra Chiini of Timbuktu, which is non-tonal and uses subject-verb-object word order.
